name: TPF Induction (Docetaxel / CISplatin / Fluorouracil), Locally Advanced Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: TPF is a cytotoxic induction backbone used as a sequential (induction) strategy in locally advanced disease before radiation-based local therapy; it is not biomarker-selected.

premedications.name: Docetaxel corticosteroid premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication (e.g. dexamethasone) around each docetaxel dose per docetaxel labeling to reduce fluid retention and hypersensitivity.

premedications.name: CISplatin hydration and antiemetics
premedications.notes: IV hydration and high-emetic-risk antiemetic prophylaxis before cisplatin.

supportiveCare: Antiemetic prophylaxis: high emetic risk (cisplatin-containing); prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
G-CSF / antibacterial prophylaxis is commonly used with TPF given the febrile-neutropenia risk; assess per institutional practice.
Fluoropyrimidine safety: consider DPYD genotyping before fluorouracil; reduce or avoid in DPYD deficiency.
Mucositis and diarrhea supportive care during infusional fluorouracil.
monitoring: CBC before each cycle and for febrile neutropenia between cycles
renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cisplatin dose
audiometry / neuropathy assessment with cumulative cisplatin
response assessment after induction to guide the next local therapy step

doseModificationRules.condition: renal impairment or cytopenia on day 1
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: febrile neutropenia or grade 3-4 mucositis in a prior cycle
doseModificationRules.text: Consider dose reduction and growth-factor support before the next cycle; physician decides.

drugs.name: Docetaxel
drugs.notes: Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 21 days for 3 induction cycles, given before cisplatin and infusional fluorouracil in the TPF induction sequence. Requires corticosteroid premedication. Dosing reflects the standard sequential-therapy TPF induction schedule (general oncology reference).

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: CISplatin 100 mg/m2 IV on day 1 (after docetaxel), every 21 days for 3 induction cycles, with adequate hydration. ISMP tall-man applied. Standard TPF induction platinum dose (general oncology reference).

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (infusional)
drugs.notes: Infusional fluorouracil 1,000 mg/m2 per day by continuous IV infusion over 96 hours (days 1 to 4), every 21 days for 3 induction cycles. Consider DPYD testing before treatment; deficiency substantially increases fluoropyrimidine toxicity. Standard TPF induction fluorouracil schedule (general oncology reference).

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
